# vendor/openplc/scripts

Treatment OpenPLC runtime support.

## Files

- [`modbus_bridge.py`](modbus_bridge.py): source-backed treatment controller/simulator Modbus bridge.
- [`native_plc_runtime.py`](native_plc_runtime.py): wrapper that starts the native controller or simulator runtime from tracked payloads.
- [`payloads/`](payloads/README.md): tracked sourceless runtime payloads required by the treatment backend.

Generated `__pycache__` files in this directory are ignored and are not the source of truth.
